module: Shared session save and load helper for the editor's custom spline and zone tools. It handles what is identical for all tools: the portable JSON envelope (version, tool, mapName, items or state, globals, records), file reading/writing, the load loop in replace or merge mode, the Save / Save As / Load buttons at the top of the window and the Replace/Merge modal window. Everything tool-specific goes through a spec table. Wiring reference: heroRoadEditor and roadSpline.
usage:
local session = extensions.editor_toolUtilities_session
local spec = {toolId = 'myTool', displayName = 'My Tool', itemNoun = 'zones', getItems = getItems,
  serializeItem = function(it) return session.itemToTable(it, nil, {'runtimeHandle'}) end,
  deserializeItem = deserializeItem, clearAll = clearAll, deepCopyAll = deepCopyAll,
  transUndo = undoFn, transRedo = redoFn}
-- in the window rendering:
session.renderButtons(spec)
-- from the rebuild pass:
session.markEdited('myTool')
notes: Required spec fields: toolId, getItems, serializeItem + deserializeItem (or getState + loadWhole for a global-state tool), clearAll, deepCopyAll, transUndo, transRedo.

Optional spec fields: displayName, itemNoun, refreshIdMap, onLoaded, logTag, version (default 1), noMerge (single document: a Load always replaces), altItemsKey (old array key accepted), iconColor, iconSize (default 36x36), saveIcon/saveAsIcon/loadIcon, getGlobals/applyGlobals (the tool's global settings, applied only in Replace), getRecords/applyRecords (large records, never set the modified state), loadJson, loadOptions, noLoadGuard.
The state (bound path, modified flag, load guard, globals baseline) is kept per toolId; the tables are local to the module and specific to the run.
A merge gives a new identifier (Engine.generateUUID) to an incoming item whose id already exists.
After a Load in Replace (except keepUnbound), the tool is bound to the file: subsequent Saves overwrite it without asking. Terrain changes are not saved.
markEdited: the load guard swallows exactly one call, that of the forced rebuild caused by a Load.
Load errors are logged with log('E', ...); the file is written by jsonWriteFile and read by jsonReadFile.

markEdited.desc: Marks a tool's document as modified (unsaved). To be called from the tool's rebuild pass, once per pass. The load guard swallows one call after a Load.

unbind.desc: Detaches a tool from its file: the next Save will have to ask where to write instead of silently overwriting the last loaded file.

attachment.desc: Returns the file the document is attached to and whether it has unsaved changes.

boundPath.desc: Returns only the bound path, for per-frame calls that must not allocate a table.

windowTitle.desc: Window title naming the bound file (or newName before there is one, "New Session" by default). The id follows "###" so that ImGui keeps the docking and size. Cached per tool.

newName.desc: Name displayed as long as no file is bound.

reattach.desc: Restores the file binding and the modified state from a table returned by attachment (for example after an extension reload).

at.desc: { path, dirty }; ignored if it is not a table.

itemToTable.desc: Deep copy of an item via the string.buffer codec (encode then decode), optionally with keys replaced by {} or removed. Used to write serializeItem without mutating the live item.

emptyKeys.desc: Keys to replace with an empty table.

rehydrateVec3Array.desc: Converts in place an array of positions loaded from JSON (plain {x,y,z}) into vec3. Idempotent (existing vec3s, which have a distance method, are left as is); safe on nil or a non-table.

saveToFile.desc: Writes all items to path as portable session JSON: version, tool, mapName (current level), items or state, globals, records.

saveIfEdited.desc: Rewrites the modified document to the file it is bound to, for a tool whose work must never wait for a Save press. Returns false if there is no bound file or no modification.

loadJson.desc: Applies an already decoded session JSON. replace first clears the current items (and applies globals/records); otherwise the loaded items are merged, an id already in use receiving a new UUID. For a global-state tool, passes state to spec.loadWhole.

replace.desc: true to replace, false to merge.

returns.desc: Number of items loaded, or error message ("not a valid <toolId> session file").

loadFromFile.desc: Reads the JSON file then applies spec.loadJson if it exists, otherwise the module's loadJson.

replace.desc: true to replace, false to merge.

returns.desc: keepUnbound (partial file) when spec.loadJson returns it.

renderButtons.desc: Inline variant: draws Save (once a file is known), Save As (if the tool is not empty) and Load side by side, then the Replace/Merge modal window.

renderButtonsColumns.desc: Column variant: draws Save, Save As and Load as three grid cells.
